sources.title: Llama-3.1-8B: Advanced 8B Transformer Model - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: Llama-3.1-8B is a dense Transformer-based foundation model featuring 8 billion parameters and novel architectural enhancements such as Grouped Query Attention and SwiGLU. The model leverages extensive multilingual pretraining and advanced tokenization to deliver high inference efficiency and superior text comprehension across multiple languages.
